resources.string: Memory is off: Bothy won\'t remember anything new or use what it already remembers. Everything remembered is kept and used again once you turn it back on.
Nothing remembered yet. Tell Bothy “Remember my home is in Wangjing Garden”, “I usually set the AC to 22 degrees” or “Call me Lao Wang”, or add it by hand below.
Let Bothy remember what you tell it

Bothy only remembers what you tell it yourself about yourself, never passwords, verification codes, ID numbers or bank card numbers; at most %1$d in all, %2$d per kind. Memories stay on this device and are not written to the logs (what you say in a conversation is logged like any other conversation); “Clear runtime data” does not delete them. “Clear memories only” keeps past conversations, so Bothy may still see what you said when it looks back through them; if someone else will use the device, use “Clear memories and conversations”.

plurals.name: memory_clear_memories_text
plurals.item: Bothy will forget the %1$d thing it remembers. This can\'t be undone. Past conversations are kept, so Bothy may still see what you said when it looks back through them.
Bothy will forget the %1$d things it remembers. This can\'t be undone. Past conversations are kept, so Bothy may still see what you said when it looks back through them.

plurals.name: memory_clear_all_text
plurals.item: This deletes the %1$d thing Bothy remembers and every conversation, along with lessons, generated images and run logs (the same as “Clear runtime data”). Running tasks will stop. Model services, keys and settings are kept. This can\'t be undone.

Write a full sentence, such as “Home is Building 3, Wangjing Garden” or “I usually set the AC to 22 degrees”. Bothy will know it in every conversation from then on.

Lessons Bothy sums up after finishing tasks, such as which service answers a kind of request fastest or which one keeps failing. A lesson takes effect only after it holds up in several tasks; it is used only to get things done faster and more reliably and has nothing to do with your personal information.
